title: President Appoints 14 Judicial Officers as Judges and Additional Judges of Delhi, J&K and Ladakh, Jharkhand and Karnataka High Courts
body_text:
In exercise of the power conferred by the Constitution of India, after consultation with Chief Justice of India, the President is pleased to appoint the following Judicial Officers as Judges/Additional Judges in the High Courts:-
S. No. Name of the recommendee (S/Shri) Details Smt. Nivedita Anil Sharma Appointed as Judges of the Delhi High Court Smt. Nisha Sahay Saxena Sanjay Sharma Appointed as Additional Judges of the Delhi High Court Bharat Parashar Dr. (Smt.) Aditi Choudhary Dinesh Bhatt Arun Bhardwaj Yash Paul Bourney Appointed as a Judge of the J&K and Ladakh High Court Manoj Prasad Appointed as Judges of the Jharkhand High Court Akhil Kumar Ram Sharma Smt. Usharani Appointed as Additional Judges of the Karnataka High Court K.S. Bharath Kumar Smt. Nerale V. Bhavani
(Narayan Prasad)
Director
